#   ⟨61⟩ adaption-legal_claim_verification 
This dataset contains pairs of legal text prompts and completions that verify claims against provided evidence passages. Each entry classifies the relationship as 'SUPPORTED', 'CONTRADICTED', or 'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE' based on textual entailment. The samples cover various legal domains including court orders, statutory provisions, and contractual agreements, often highlighting specific logical negations or modal reversals.
###   ⟨53⟩ Dataset size 
There are 20,000 data points in this dataset. This is an instruction tuning dataset.
